dialogues.speaker: Ji Tong
dialogues.text: Definitely need to investigate this Kamera more closely...

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: How have the photos turned out? Let me see...

choices.text: Where did you get this Kamera?

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Oh, I bought it off a merchant from Fontaine.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: He said this model prints photos with a unique effect, which is certain to make it catch on.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: I took him at his word, but I quickly discovered that I don't recognize anything that this Kamera prints...

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Maybe I'm using it wrong? But I don't know how to track him down, ugh...

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Bye... Ugh, this Kamera, such a konundrum...
